Father of Śrī Lakṣmīpriyā Devī, the first wife of Mahāprabhu (Murāri 1.9.6, Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka 3.6, Caitanya-bhāgavata 1.7.73, Caitanya-caritāmṛta 2.1.249, Vaiṣṇava-vandanā of Jīva 115-116, Devakīnandana 40, Vṛndāvana dāsa 39). His parents and family are not mentioned. The Prema-vilāsa (20) names a Vallabhācārya, author of the Kṛṣṇa-maṅgala (see also «Mādhavācārya»).

The record «Vallabha Miśra» #1605 was the same person and was joined to this one (15-11-2026, Whisper).
